title: Chapter close — Braids and Knots
html: This completes Step 2 of the five-step arc: the braid group B_n, its Iwahori–Hecke quotient H_n(q), the Kazhdan–Lusztig bar involution, the Jones–Markov trace \mathrm{tr}_M at z = q^3/(q^2+1), and the quantum-group centralizer \mathcal{U}_q(\mathfrak{su}(2)). In the next chapter (Bring's Surface), the pipeline passes to Step 3 by embedding these braid and Hecke operators into the genus-four hyperbolic curve \Sigma_4 (\chi(\Sigma_4) = -6), where surface homology and the (2,4,5) hyperbolic tiling provide the geometric arena for the particle dictionary (Knots, Particles, and Confinement), flavor multiplets (The Eightfold Way and Flavor Structure), and the categorical mass functional (The Mass Endomorphism).
